title: Amount of a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit Line on a Covered or Graduated-Return Due Date
content:
**Clause.** On a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a line is scheduled for the loan's next due date as its Personal Loans record shows it. A due date on or before the end of military service captured on the benefit, or any due date of a benefit with no end of military service captured, is a covered due date, and its line is for the plan installment recorded on the benefit, rounded to the cent.

The line on a graduated-return due date is for the previous line's amount plus the whole step up from it to the pre-plan installment recorded on the benefit, so that the loan's pre-plan installment resumes on that due date; the previous line's amount is the amount of the plan installment lines on the latest due date already carrying one on the benefit, all of them taken together where several share that due date, or the plan installment recorded on the benefit where none exists, held to no more than the larger of the plan installment and the pre-plan installment recorded on the benefit, and the step up is the pre-plan installment less the previous line's amount, never below zero. The graduated-return installment is rounded to the cent once, on the final figure.

Where another rule of this policy replaces the share of the step up charged, the replacement takes its place; every point that applies is then subtracted from that share, never taking it below zero, and the share so reached is applied once to the step up and added to the previous line's amount.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: plan installment 250.00 USD, pre-plan installment 400.00 USD)

| Due date | Lines on the latest due date already carrying one | Previous line's amount | Step up | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| on or before the end of military service | — | — | — | 250.00 USD |
| after it | one line of 250.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 400.00 USD |
| after it | two lines, 250.00 and 30.00 | 280.00 | 120.00 | 400.00 USD |
| after it | one line of 450.00 | 400.00 (held to the larger of 250.00 and 400.00) | 0.00 | 400.00 USD |
| after it | none | 250.00 (the plan installment) | 150.00 | 400.00 USD |
